title: AI Assistant for Healthcare Professionals
metaTitle: AI Assistant for Healthcare Professionals: Admin and Email
metaDescription: Spend less time on paperwork between patients. GAIA triages non-clinical email, coordinates schedules, drafts admin letters, and organizes research.
intro: Healthcare professionals face one of the heaviest administrative burdens of any profession. A 2024 AMA survey found that physicians spend an average of 15.5 hours per week on administrative tasks, with electronic communication and paperwork consuming time that could go toward patient care. Importantly, GAIA operates strictly in the administrative and productivity layer: it does not access clinical systems, electronic health records, or protected health information. GAIA is source-available (PolyForm Noncommercial), and healthcare organizations with compliance requirements can self-host it (for-profit practices under an enterprise license (contact the GAIA team); public health and non-profit organizations under the noncommercial license), keeping administrative workflows within their own infrastructure in support of those requirements.
painPoints: Administrative email volume including scheduling requests, referrals, and departmental communications creates daily inbox overload
Scheduling complexity across clinics, hospitals, and patient appointments requires constant coordination
Staying current with medical research and literature is difficult given time constraints
Documentation overhead for administrative correspondence and inter-departmental coordination adds non-clinical workload
Coordinating between departments, specialists, and administrative staff involves extensive back-and-forth communication

howGaiaHelps.title: Non-Clinical Email Triage
howGaiaHelps.description: GAIA triages your administrative Gmail inbox, categorizing messages by type including scheduling requests, departmental communications, research updates, and administrative tasks. It drafts responses for routine correspondence and surfaces urgent items immediately. GAIA does not access or process clinical records or protected health information.

howGaiaHelps.title: Scheduling and Appointment Coordination
howGaiaHelps.description: GAIA manages administrative scheduling through Google Calendar, coordinates meeting and appointment logistics via email, and handles the back-and-forth of multi-party scheduling across departments and specialist referrals.

howGaiaHelps.title: Research and Literature Organization
howGaiaHelps.description: GAIA uses Perplexity to surface relevant medical research and literature, organizes findings in Notion by specialty and topic, and creates structured reading lists so staying current with your field becomes systematic rather than sporadic.

howGaiaHelps.title: Administrative Correspondence Drafting
howGaiaHelps.description: GAIA drafts professional administrative correspondence including inter-departmental emails, referral coordination messages, meeting agendas, and administrative documentation, reducing the time spent on non-clinical writing.

howGaiaHelps.title: Consultation Round Preparation
howGaiaHelps.description: GAIA organizes administrative materials and schedules for patient consultation rounds, prepares agenda documents from Notion, and ensures all coordination logistics are handled before rounds begin.

faqs.question: Does GAIA access electronic health records or patient data?
faqs.answer: No. GAIA operates strictly in the administrative and productivity layer. It does not connect to EHR systems, access protected health information, or process any clinical data. It manages administrative email, scheduling, research organization, and non-clinical correspondence only.

faqs.question: Can GAIA be deployed in a HIPAA-compliant manner?
faqs.answer: GAIA is source-available (PolyForm Noncommercial). For-profit practices can self-host GAIA under an enterprise license (contact the GAIA team), and public health and non-profit organizations under the noncommercial license, deploying it entirely within their own infrastructure and keeping complete control over data flows, which can support organizational and regulatory requirements for administrative systems.

faqs.question: How does GAIA help physicians manage their administrative email load?
faqs.answer: GAIA monitors your Gmail for administrative messages, categorizes them by type and urgency, drafts responses for routine requests, and ensures high-priority items surface promptly. Physicians report that administrative email management alone can consume an hour or more daily, which GAIA significantly reduces.
